g.text: The full connection string, password included,
No Depends(), no API key, no token or session check.
The only credential check in the app:
Postgres verifies the user/password in DATABASE_URL.
Every request runs as that single database user,
never as the person using the page.
may SELECT both tables; only care_management may
updated_at. These apply only if DATABASE_URL
signs in as one of those users.
